user.title: MAestro Cards
user.description: Adds the MAestro cards (player, thermostat) and their badges to Home Assistant and lets every user (not only admins) use the player's DSP. No settings needed.

init.title: MAestro Cards
init.description: Found {players} Music Assistant players and {thermostats} thermostats. Tick the ones the cards should use. Settings made directly in a card always win.

data.player_theme: Default color scheme of the player
data.thermostat_theme: Default color scheme of the thermostat

data_description.players: Shown in the player's multiroom list. Nothing ticked = all players.
data_description.thermostats: Shown in the thermostat's list of other thermostats. Nothing ticked = all thermostats.

power.title: Power buttons
power.description: Optionally pick the receiver / amplifier for each ticked player. The player card and badge then show a power button for it, and the multiroom list too.

options.auto: By mode (thermostat: heat orange, cool blue, off grey)
